task_summary: Customer reports that the Framed Wall Art from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged in transit. The correct resolution is the shipping-damage protocol: review the shipping and return policy, issue a full refund to the original payment method, provide a prepaid return label, and if the item is classified as fragile, include the separate fragile-item goodwill credit.

Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.
